MK: Provides accurate information to refute common immunization concerns in a confident manner.
Accurately addresses potential side effects of vaccine
Accurately discusses risks or sequelae of the vaccine-preventable disease.
SBP: Provides or suggests additional resources for the parent
Makes concrete plans/arranges follow up to either receive the vaccine or continue discussion e.g., “let’s make an appointment again next week to talk about this”
ICS: Uses best practice presumptive approach (e.g., “Your child is due to receive XX vaccines today”)
Uses non-judgmental and non-confrontational verbal language throughout
Uses non-judgmental and non-confrontational body language throughout AND sits down for the conversation
Asks open-ended questions to elicit parental concerns.
Expresses empathy AND corroborates parental concerns; appears genuine
Explains own background and ability to respond to immunization questions.
